scientific_integrity: Existing q=1 periodic-orbit existence is credited to its original theorem; mathematical conclusions are supported by a new interface-flux proof and exact crossing checks.
scientific_limitations: Only q=1,k=2 with Filippov crossing; h>0 means H=-h.
Global boundedness is not asserted; bounded-forward-orbit attraction is leafwise only.
The strict multiplier has no closed numerical form here.
Full-text historical priority comparison for the 2024 article is incomplete.
No independent audit has been conducted.
title: Uniqueness, strict crossing stability and an energy-invariant multiplier for the discontinuous generalized Chazy cylinder
